$schema: committed test-lane classification for US-30 AC-30.1

rejected.label: Naming convention enforced by a test (e.g. a `.live.test.ts` suffix)
rejected.reason: Only 4 of 156 suites are LIVE and several LIVE-sounding filenames (webhook-live-proof, backstage-client-flow-a's sibling files, r2-storage) are actually UNIT once read — baking the lane into the filename would conflate 'reads about live behaviour' with 'is live behaviour', which is exactly the guessing-from-filename failure mode AC-30.1 forbids. It would also require renaming files across git history for no functional gain over an explicit manifest.

rejected.label: A testPathIgnorePatterns pair (two Jest configs/invocations, each ignoring the other lane's suites)
rejected.reason: Works, but the LIVE and UNIT suite sets aren't derivable from a path pattern (see naming-convention rejection above), so each config would need its own explicit include/exclude list duplicating the same manifest in two places, and running both lanes from one `npm test` would require chaining two separate `jest --config` invocations rather than one Jest run — more moving parts than a single `projects` config needs.

mechanism.notes: This AC records the classification and the mechanism decision only. Wiring jest.config.ts's `projects` array to the two lanes, and the package.json/CI scripts that select them, is scoped to AC-30.2/30.3/30.5.
